image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a bright yellow coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavulinopsis species) growing from dark, mossy soil. The fungus features multiple upright, cylindrical branches that fork slightly near the tips. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), showing hints of green leaves and brown earth, emphasizing the sharp focus on the fungal structure.
